tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The page behind everything: warm paper in light, warm charcoal in dark. Text on it: `ink`, `muted`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, inputs and the selected tab. Always sits on `canvas`. Text on it: `ink`, `muted`.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: the tab track, progress-bar tracks, neutral chips, hovered rows. Text on it: `ink`, `muted`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `canvas`, `surface`, `sunken` and every `-soft` tint. Also the fill of the floating Save bar (with `canvas` text).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, times, labels, hints, finished items. 4.5:1 or better on `canvas`, `surface`, `sunken` and every `-soft` tint.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only; it does not mark a control's edge (use `line-strong`).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: The edge of inputs, selects, outlined buttons and unchecked checkboxes. 3:1 or better on `canvas` and `surface`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 3px keyboard focus ring on every control. 3:1 or better on `canvas`, `surface` and `sunken`.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any solid fill: `brand`, the four panel colors, `danger` and `person-1` to `person-6`. 4.5:1 or better on each, in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Clay, the family's signature color: the primary button, today's date, the current navigation item, selected states. Also usable as text on `canvas`, `surface` and `brand-soft`.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Light clay wash behind today's tile and brand chips. Text on it: `ink`, `muted`, `brand`.

tokens.name: calendar
tokens.usage: Calendar's panel color: its icon badge, its links and its chips. Text on `surface`, `canvas` and `calendar-soft`.

tokens.name: calendar-soft
tokens.usage: Calendar's tint: icon badge background, chip background.

tokens.name: todo
tokens.usage: To-do's panel color (plum): its icon, checkboxes and chips.

tokens.name: todo-soft
tokens.usage: To-do's tint: icon badge background, chip background.

tokens.name: chores
tokens.usage: Chores' panel color (amber, darkened so it reads as text): its icon, checkboxes and chips.

tokens.name: chores-soft
tokens.usage: Chores' tint: icon badge background, chip background.

tokens.name: spend
tokens.usage: Spend's panel color (green): its icon, bar fills and chips.

tokens.name: spend-soft
tokens.usage: Spend's tint: icon badge background, chip background.

tokens.name: savings
tokens.usage: Savings' panel color (teal): its icon, graph line and checkboxes.

tokens.name: savings-soft
tokens.usage: Savings' tint: icon badge background, chip background.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, overdue and late. A cranberry, deliberately cooler than `brand` so the two aren't confused; always with words ("Overdue", an error sentence), never color alone. Text on `canvas`, `surface` and `danger-soft`.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Wash behind an error notice or late chip.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a dialog.

tokens.name: person-1
tokens.usage: A family member's color (clay). Fills their avatar and their events, with `on-fill` text.

tokens.name: person-2
tokens.usage: A family member's color (blue).

tokens.name: person-3
tokens.usage: A family member's color (plum).

tokens.name: person-4
tokens.usage: A family member's color (green).

tokens.name: person-5
tokens.usage: A family member's color (amber).

tokens.name: person-6
tokens.usage: A family member's color (teal).

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart slot 1 (blue). Slots are used in this fixed order, largest slice first, never cycled; a ninth series folds into Other. Marks only (slices, swatches), never text. 3:1 or better on `surface`.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart slot 2 (orange).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart slot 3 (aqua).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart slot 4 (ochre).

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart slot 5 (magenta).

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Chart slot 6 (green).

tokens.name: chart-7
tokens.usage: Chart slot 7 (violet).

tokens.name: chart-8
tokens.usage: Chart slot 8 (red).

tokens.name: chart-other
tokens.usage: The Other slice and its swatches: a neutral, so it never reads as a series. The same values as `line-strong`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The family name in the top bar and page titles. One per page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A drill-down's page title and a dialog's title.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The one big number on a card: the month's spend.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Group headings inside a card: Today, Yours, Up for grabs.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: To-do and chore titles, event titles, form text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button text, tab text, emphasized values.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Due dates, times, field labels, hints.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a button and its neighbor; between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside a row; between small cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page padding on phones; padding inside a row.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding on tablets and wall displays; gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above a page title.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, event blocks inside a day.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Day tiles, notices, inner panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tabs, avatars, bars, checkboxes.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and the selected tab: a soft, warm lift off `canvas`.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Floating things only: the Save bar and dialogs.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every button, input, tab and row. Generous for small hands and wall tablets.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icon size in a 24px grid.

tokens.name: check
tokens.usage: Checkbox circle (padded to 48px hit area).

tokens.name: avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Avatar next to a row or in a stack.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: Avatar in the top bar.
